traits.Spider Climb: The broodmother can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing an ability check.
traits.Web Sense: While in contact with a web, she knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.
traits.Web Walker: She ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.
traits.Drop From Above: She has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that has not yet acted this combat.

actions.name: Bite
actions.note: The target must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw, taking 3d8 poison damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

actions.name: Web
actions.note: The target is wrapped and hauled toward the dark. As an action, the restrained target can make a DC 14 Strength check to tear free.
